The '''Collector Limpet Controller''' launches limpet drones that retrieve loose cargo canisters, materials, and mined fragments or chunks and bring them back to the ship.

== Overview ==

Collector limpets are core equipment for mining builds — picking up fragments blasted off asteroids — as well as for salvage, collecting cargo ejected from destroyed or looted ships. A Commander who wants to actually keep the proceeds of mining or salvage generally needs collectors running; without them, loose cargo drifts away or must be scooped manually.

== Mining role ==

Collector limpets support every main mining method:

* [[Laser Mining]] — collect ordinary fragments broken loose by mining lasers.
* [[Core Mining]] — collect fragments and deposits after detonation and abrasion blasting.
* [[Sub-surface Mining]] — collect chunks released by displacement missiles.
* [[Surface Deposit Mining]] — collect deposits dislodged by an abrasion blaster.

For mining, launch collectors without a specific fragment targeted unless a one-use pickup is intended. Limpets also need a clear path; flying too close to rock can destroy them quickly.
